modeReason: Several distinct stories today (an AI's false police tip, a flood of math results stunning mathematicians, an AI-powered disinformation campaign, a publisher staff revolt, and a drone strike on an AI datacenter) each score novelty×magnitude×breadth of 12, well above the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: One AI amazed mathematicians with a flood of new proofs. Another AI sent police a false tip about an unsolved killing, and nobody noticed for two months.
phraseAlternatives: Mathematicians are still stunned by one AI's flood of new proofs. Another AI's false tip to police went unnoticed for two months.
One lab's AI produced math results nobody can fully check yet. Another lab's AI sent police a false lead that took two months to catch.
An AI stunned the math world with new proofs. A different AI gave police a false lead, and it took two months to notice.

brief.concept: A robot dazzles human mathematicians with a wall of brand-new proofs, while a second robot's false tip to the police goes unnoticed for months.
brief.metaphor: Genius and error live in the same machine: one display stuns with brilliance, the other's mistake sits undetected in plain sight.

cast.who: a robot chalking a dense wall of equations onto an overflowing blackboard
a human mathematician staring up at the blackboard, mouth open in disbelief
a second robot slipping a folded note into a tip box
a wall calendar with two months of pages torn off, curling with dust

brief.composition: Two side-by-side panels on one card, separated by a thin vertical divider. Left panel: an equation-covered blackboard fills most of the frame with a small robot beside it; a mathematician in the foreground looks up, overwhelmed. Right panel: a tip box sits center with the second robot's hand mid-drop; a torn calendar hangs on the wall behind, shown with faint dust cross-hatching to suggest passed time.
brief.alt: Split image: on the left a robot covers a blackboard with equations while a mathematician stares up in disbelief; on the right a second robot drops a folded note into a tip box beneath a calendar with two months of torn-off pages.
